title: 4th of July Coloring Book for Kids Ages 3-7: 50 Big and Simple Patriotic Designs with Cute Eagles, Fireworks, and Stars
subtitle: Bold and Easy Independence Day Coloring Pages with Kawaii Patriotic Characters, Flags, and Red White Blue Fun for Toddlers and Preschoolers
description:
Celebrate the 4th of July with the cutest patriotic coloring adventure!


This adorable coloring book features 50 big, bold, and easy-to-color patriotic designs perfect for little hands ages 3-7. Every page is filled with kawaii eagles, smiling fireworks, friendly stars, cute Uncle Sam hats, and sweet red-white-blue treats — all with the happiest faces your child will love!

What's Inside:
• 50 unique kawaii patriotic illustrations
• Cute eagles, fireworks, flags, Statue of Liberty, popsicles, and more
• Single-sided pages to prevent bleed-through
• Large 8.5 x 8.5 inch square pages for comfortable coloring
• Bold, easy-to-color outlines — perfect for crayons, markers, and colored pencils

Perfect For:
• 4th of July celebrations and BBQ activities
• Independence Day gifts and party favors
• Road trip and travel entertainment
• Beginners and little artists ages 3-7

Grab your red, white, and blue crayons and let the patriotic fun begin!

cover_prompt: Full-color vibrant cartoon illustration for a children's coloring book cover. SQUARE format (1:1 aspect ratio). A cheerful kawaii scene celebrating the 4th of July: a cute round-faced bald eagle wearing a tiny Uncle Sam top hat, holding a sparkler, surrounded by colorful fireworks bursting in red, white, and blue across the sky. Small kawaii stars with happy faces float around. Below the eagle is a row of cute waving American flags and red-white-blue bunting banners. Bright blue sky background with soft white clouds. Vibrant saturated colors, professional children's book cover art, eye-catching and cheerful. DO NOT include any text in the image.
